# iaas_microvm_images (Data Source)

Lists platform and account MicroVM images, with optional local filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iaas_microvm_images" "ready" {
  status = "ready"
}

output "microvm_image_ids" {
  value = [for image in data.iaas_microvm_images.ready.images : image.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Exact source kind: base, dockerfile, oci, or git.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive image-name substring.
- `status` (String) Exact image status.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images--suggested_secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images.suggested_secrets`

Read-Only:

- `help_url` (String)
- `icon` (String) Icon key of the row. Null when the kit does not set it.
- `label` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `placeholder` (String) Placeholder text of the launcher field. Null when the kit does not set it.
- `provider` (String) Provider key the secret belongs to (for example anthropic). Null when the kit does not set it.
- `role` (String) provider (feeds the secrets token) or repo (the repo access line). Null on a kit published before roles existed.
